activity_thresholds.use: annotation only; retain every planned call and interval; never discard/replace because flagged

limitations: Two untimed samples per arm/mix, one diagnostic timed call per arm; no exclusions. Whole-command monitoring includes allocation/oracles and cannot isolate every100-dispatch window.
Sparse timestamps, CPU contention and system-wide disk/GPU activity cannot establish a cause for timing differences. Untimed first mixed shape is particularly noisy.
Controlled subnormals are hash-distributed at about0.25%; they are not real-model weights. No causal claim about repair divergence follows.
253952 finite checks compare numerical products, so they do not prove output zero signs or NaN payload handling; the65536-bit Python formula proof is not compiled GPU evidence.
C timing tradeoffs are evaluated over every small row and the large output head. Only a whole-model screen can assess the workload-weighted tradeoff; no HF, long-context or landing gate completed.
recommendation: Proceed with authorized bounded main/C/mx six-call F16 model screen; all controls passed and whole-shape tradeoff supports measuring the model. No C promotion or full gates.

decision.rationale: Every normal/mixed C wall mean improves over main, including the head. One mixed3072x1024 wall mean regresses3.87% vsB, while timedGPU improves17.14%; retain both and evaluate model-weighted tradeoff. No promotion/fullgate claim.

root_conversion_inspection.scope: Final shader ISA contains the proposed exact F32 subtraction, expressed as addition of -0.5.

host_proof.scope: prospective host formula only; no compiled GPU or speed claim
host_proof.argument: At exponent -1 each F32 mantissa unit is 2^-24. Subtracting 0.5 yields m*2^-24 exactly; all nonzero results are normal F32.
